items.text: With costs on the rise, families across the nation are struggling with putting food on the table. I am thrilled the White House has announced the date for their conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health, which will be held on September 28.

Today, I’m participating in the White House Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health - which I helped fund as Chair of the House Appropriations Committee.

It’s time we end hunger in the U.S. by enacting policies, like the monthly Child Tax Credit, that help keep families fed.

I’m at the White House Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health discussing ways we can end hunger in the United States.

Tune in ⬇️

https://t.co/vh693uNzb7

This week, I joined the White House Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health for a panel with my friends @SecBecerra @SenStabenow & @NYCMayor on how we move forward our work to end hunger in the United States.

Watch my remarks here. ⬇️ https://t.co/0WS5nHC5lD

It means a great deal to me to join Griffin Health and all of the breast cancer advocates at the Hewitt Center for Breast Wellness in Derby to talk about what we must do to detect breast cancer early and save women’s lives. https://t.co/NXiuseFgDQ

In my home state of CT, people are going hungry. Families continue to face an economic crisis that has left too many struggling to obtain the food and nutrition they need.

Now is the time to invest in these programs — and not let the @GOP strip them away.
https://t.co/8jr2UV2bo7

.@AppropsDems' Community Project Funding addresses specific community needs across the country and is making an impact in CT-03.

Today I announced that Stratford received more than $4 million to support its Water Pollution Control Facility!
https://t.co/VOYewiNxhT

We must address lowering the cost of insulin for hardworking CT families.
 
Today in Ansonia, I stood with advocates to announce that Eli Lilly is capping the out-of-pocket costs of its insulin at $35 a month! No family should ever struggle to afford lifesaving medical treatment. https://t.co/e1tLkEG8JG
No American should ever struggle to afford lifesaving medical treatment. Because of the #InflationReductionAct, seniors in CT will save $590 this year!

Republican calls to cut government funding put everything from child care to opioid treatment and mental health services to nutrition assistance at risk for millions.

I'm leading @AppropsDems to fight these extreme cuts. 

Tune in: https://t.co/y1o0BG6fWQ

Preventive services detect diseases early on, allowing Americans the opportunity to seek out treatment or preventive health services before a diagnosis becomes a death sentence.  

This decision is deadly and must be undone immediately.  
https://t.co/DdYeqL9Cf9

Today, we recognize April 10 as National Youth HIV/AIDS Awareness Day.

Together, we can help young people by encouraging HIV testing, prevention, treatment, counseling, and pushing for access to services in our communities.

Learn more here:
https://t.co/3yPxz9xoGi

No family in the U.S. — no child — should be hungry. We have the tools to end hunger and close the nutrition gap — let’s invest in them and get it done. 

I am proud to introduce the WIC Act along with my colleagues @RepJenniffer @RepLindaSanchez @RepKimSchrier & @RepBrianFitz. https://t.co/UPGF2cmbyC

Hunger plagues millions here in the U.S. and abroad. Now more than ever, we need new and innovative solutions to combat global hunger.

I look forward to working with @chefjoseandres on new ways to strengthen our commitments to enhancing nutrition and fighting hunger worldwide.

My heart breaks that @RepWexton will not be returning next Congress. In addition to being an outstanding legislator and compassionate colleague on @AppropsDems, she has shown incredible grace, resilience, and fortitude in the wake of her diagnosis. Wishing her the best.

Deputy Commissioner for Human Foods Jim Jones is leading the way to transform @US_FDA's approach to prevent foodborne illness, decrease diet-related disease, and safeguard the food supply.

I look forward to working with him closely to improve America's broken food safety system.

On this day, we must also renew our commitment to address the disparate impact of HIV on communities of color and the LGBTQI+ community by increasing access to preventive medicine, testing, and treatment, and fighting to end stigmas about HIV/AIDS.

There are few people in the world doing as much to combat hunger and promote nutrition as @chefjoseandres. I look forward to working together to continue tackling one of the most pressing issues of our time.

Thank you for all you do, my friend. https://t.co/wCtqT9Wpyv

The discovery made by Vallisure is alarming. Millions of consumers are unknowingly using a product that increases their exposure to life threatening carcinogens.

We must enact my Recall Unsafe Drugs Act & empower FDA to recall unsafe products.

https://t.co/We3y1FLSzm

I was honored to present Dr. Francis Collins with the @preventcancer Visionary Award for his scientific & medical breakthroughs in cancer prevention.

This announcement is a huge step in combating world hunger.

These funds maximize Ready-to-Use Therapeutic Food (RUTF) & other supplemental nutrition commodities for areas most in need, building on USAID’s life-saving nutrition support in places like Gaza and Sudan.

If Republicans were serious about improving health outcomes for Americans, they would support proven and effective hunger and nutrition programs.

Instead, they do nothing to address the price gouging of mega groceries that raise the cost of food for struggling American families. https://t.co/an6CzWryXF
